providers.notes: Pairing URI may exist in memory only and must be redacted from logs or WorldzProof.
Connection-only adapter must expose authorized accounts without registering sign or execute methods.

rules: WorldzApp initiates wallet handoff from the first-party app surface.
No wallet-browser URL pasting is required as a product rule.
No seed phrase or private key is collected.
OAuth or WalletConnect credentials are never written into the public Worldz session.
Provider origins and first-party return origins must be explicitly allowlisted.
Signing remains a later separately reviewed gate.
